nodes.description: Current owner address of the contract; written in initOwner and claimOwnership and read in onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address for two-step ownership transfer; written in transferOwnership and claimOwnership.
Initialization flag guarding initOwner via notInitialized modifier.
Global minimum fragment threshold (per 1000) used in buyout qualification math.
Global maximum fragment threshold (per 1000) used in buyout qualification math.
Buyout fee returned when a user qualifies for buyout.
Mapping of fragment token address to FragInfo configuration (min/max frag, buyoutAddr, isSet).
Public initialization that sets _INITIALIZED_ and assigns _OWNER_ to an arbitrary caller-supplied address without any access control.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner into _NEW_OWNER_.
Completes ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == _NEW_OWNER_ then rewrites _OWNER_.
onlyOwner function adding a FragInfo struct for a fragment token address.
onlyOwner function updating min/max frag and buyout address for an existing frag entry.
onlyOwner function updating global fragment bounds and buyout fee (with int cast).
External view function computing buyout eligibility; performs external calls to IERC20 and IBuyout on caller-supplied/owner-supplied addresses.
Untrusted caller address used for onlyOwner checks, ownership claim checks and initialization.
Access-control sensitive initialization: anybody can call initOwner before initialization and become owner.
Authorization check msg.sender == _NEW_OWNER_ guarding the ownership state transition.
onlyOwner-guarded privileged state writes for ownership staging and global parameter configuration.
External call to IBuyout(buyoutAddr).getBuyoutQualification(user) on an owner-controlled, potentially malicious address.
External calls IERC20(fragAddr).balanceOf/totalSupply on an arbitrary fragment token address.
newOwner argument of initOwner, directly assigned to _OWNER_.
newOwner argument of transferOwnership, stored into _NEW_OWNER_.
fragAddr argument of addFragInfo, used as mapping key.
minFrag argument of addFragInfo, stored into FragInfo.
maxFrag argument of addFragInfo, stored into FragInfo.
buyoutAddr argument of addFragInfo, later used for external call.
fragAddr argument of setFragInfo, used as mapping key.
minFrag argument of setFragInfo, written into frags entry.
maxFrag argument of setFragInfo, written into frags entry.
buyoutAddr argument of setFragInfo, written into frags entry.
minFrag argument of setGlobalParam, assigned to _MIN_FRAG_.
maxFrag argument of setGlobalParam, assigned to _MAX_FRAG_.
buyoutFee argument of setGlobalParam, cast to int and assigned to _BUYOUT_FEE_.
fragAddr argument of getBuyoutStatus, used both for map lookup and external token calls.
user argument of getBuyoutStatus, forwarded to external balance/qualification calls.
In-memory FragInfo struct built in addFragInfo and stored into frags.
Copy of the frags mapping entry read in getBuyoutStatus.
User token balance obtained from the external IERC20 call.
Fragment token total supply obtained from the external IERC20 call, used in SafeMath mul/div.
Effective minimum fragment threshold, initialized from _MIN_FRAG_ and overridden by frags entry.
Effective maximum fragment threshold, initialized from _MAX_FRAG_ and overridden by frags entry.
Buyout contract address read from FragInfo and used as target of an external call.
Boolean result returned by the external IBuyout qualification call.
Privileged mutation of an existing frags entry, gated only by onlyOwner.

edges.reason: newOwner argument is consumed by initOwner.
Untrusted initOwner argument is written directly to the privileged _OWNER_ state variable.
initOwner sets _INITIALIZED_ to true, locking initialization without any access control.
initOwner reaches the front-runnable initialization unsafe operation.
Unauthenticated caller can take ownership by writing _OWNER_.
newOwner argument is consumed by transferOwnership.
transferOwnership stages a pending owner into _NEW_OWNER_.
msg.sender is validated against _OWNER_ by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership performs an onlyOwner-guarded privileged state write.
claimOwnership rewrites the privileged _OWNER_ variable.
claimOwnership clears _NEW_OWNER_ during the ownership transition.
msg.sender must equal _NEW_OWNER_ for the ownership claim to succeed.
claimOwnership reaches the ownership authorization unsafe operation.
Authorized ownership claim propagates into the _OWNER_ state variable.
fragAddr argument indexes into the frags mapping in addFragInfo.
addFragInfo writes a new FragInfo entry into the frags mapping.
addFragInfo builds the in-memory fragInfo struct.
The in-memory fragInfo struct is copied into frags[fragAddr].
msg.sender is validated against _OWNER_ by onlyOwner before adding frag info.
addFragInfo performs an onlyOwner-guarded privileged state write.
fragAddr argument selects the frags entry mutated by setFragInfo.
setFragInfo mutates min/max frag and buyoutAddr fields of the frags mapping.
setFragInfo reaches the privileged frags mutation unsafe operation.
msg.sender is validated against _OWNER_ by onlyOwner before updating frag info.
minFrag argument is consumed by setGlobalParam.
setGlobalParam writes the privileged global _MIN_FRAG_ parameter.
setGlobalParam writes the privileged global _MAX_FRAG_ parameter.
setGlobalParam writes _BUYOUT_FEE_ after an int cast of the caller-supplied fee.
msg.sender is validated against _OWNER_ by onlyOwner before global param changes.
setGlobalParam performs an onlyOwner-guarded privileged state write.
getBuyoutStatus reads the frags entry into the local fragInfo struct.
_MIN_FRAG_ initializes the effective minFrag local variable.
_MAX_FRAG_ initializes the effective maxFrag local variable.
fragAddr argument is consumed by getBuyoutStatus for map lookup and token queries.
user argument is consumed by getBuyoutStatus.
Caller-supplied fragAddr is used as the target of external IERC20 balanceOf/totalSupply calls.
getBuyoutStatus reaches the external token call unsafe operation.
getBuyoutStatus reaches the external IBuyout qualification call on an owner-controlled address.
The external buyout contract can re-enter getBuyoutStatus (or the calling contract) during the qualification callback.
totalSupply is multiplied by minFrag/maxFrag and divided by 1000 (SafeMath) to build the buyout threshold comparison.
buyoutAddr is read out of the local fragInfo struct.
The stored buyoutAddr becomes the target of the external IBuyout call in getBuyoutStatus.
The user argument is forwarded to the external getBuyoutQualification call.
isQualified local receives its value from the external IBuyout qualification call.

normalization_plan.reason: The initOwner argument is only meaningful as input to initOwner's direct assignment to _OWNER_.
The transferOwnership argument only feeds the staged owner assignment inside transferOwnership.
The fragAddr argument is only used as the frags mapping key within addFragInfo.
The minFrag argument is only stored into the FragInfo struct inside addFragInfo.
The maxFrag argument is only stored into the FragInfo struct inside addFragInfo.
The buyoutAddr argument is only stored into the FragInfo struct inside addFragInfo.
The fragAddr argument is only used to select the frags entry updated by setFragInfo.
The minFrag argument is only written into the frags entry inside setFragInfo.
The maxFrag argument is only written into the frags entry inside setFragInfo.
The buyoutAddr argument is only written into the frags entry inside setFragInfo.
The minFrag argument is only assigned to _MIN_FRAG_ inside setGlobalParam.
The maxFrag argument is only assigned to _MAX_FRAG_ inside setGlobalParam.
The buyoutFee argument is only cast and assigned to _BUYOUT_FEE_ inside setGlobalParam.
The fragAddr argument is only used for map lookup and external token queries inside getBuyoutStatus.
The user argument is only forwarded to external balance/qualification calls inside getBuyoutStatus.
The local struct exists only to be written into frags at the end of addFragInfo.
The local struct is a transient copy of frags[fragAddr] used only inside getBuyoutStatus.
The local balance is a temporary value compared inside getBuyoutStatus.
The local total supply is a temporary value used in the threshold arithmetic of getBuyoutStatus.
The effective minFrag is a transient variable resolved inside getBuyoutStatus.
The effective maxFrag is a transient variable resolved inside getBuyoutStatus.
The local buyout address exists solely to be used as the target of the external IBuyout call.
The local qualification flag is only the boolean result of the external IBuyout call.
